title: Author the portable dogfood workflow package
description:
One production manifest/assets payload installs the repository-neutral workflow and, through the completed renderer, migrates every live skill/prompt/standard and public preset consumer to derived output in the same green change.

## Background

This is the sole production payload owner. It authors the complete adopter-neutral package and switches compatibility and live dogfood consumers together, without introducing deferred lifecycle APIs or a second inventory.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The production `profiles/jit-dogfood/` manifest and assets contain the milestone, epic, story, task, bug, enhancement, planning, and breakdown taxonomy; the epic-only plan template and enforced epic coverage; the `plan-review`, `breakdown-review`, `code-review`, `coverage-preview`, `jit-validate`, and `repo-validate` gates; their portable prompts, scripts, and structured-warning placeholder; the `jit-manage`, `jit-migrate`, `jit-planning-lead`, `jit-breakdown`, `jit-parallel`, `jit-execution-lead`, and `jit-project-lead` skills; one canonical content-standard asset; managed JIT-guidance and invariant regions for `AGENTS.md`; an empty invariant registry; and complete `invariant_projection` and `rules_gates_projection` singleton contributions. Application preserves all unmanaged bytes.
- [hard] REQ-02: For absent region targets, output is marker/content/marker plus newline; for unmarked existing targets, original bytes remain an exact prefix followed by the deterministic blank-line boundary and region; reapplication replaces only one valid matching region, while partial/duplicate/reversed/nested matching markers conflict and foreign IDs remain untouched.
- [hard] REQ-03: After application, ordinary `jit invariant render` and `jit reference render` consume the installed singleton configuration; the repository renderer switches live skills, prompts/scripts, standards, and preset definitions/assets to manifest-derived output with drift/equivalence tests and no second inventory.
- [hard] REQ-04: Installed paths need neither `jq` nor source checkout, placeholders warn structurally, and goldens exclude project-local/deferred content; `./scripts/docs-mechanical.sh .agents/skills scripts .jit/reference profiles/jit-dogfood docs/examples docs/reference` passes after render.

## Scope

**Blast radius:** package manifest and assets, semantic registry and projection golden fixtures, and renderer-owned live outputs. This task consumes existing renderer and preset-projection APIs without changing their algorithms.

**Green landing:** Application and payload golden tests prove the complete adopter-neutral workflow while no public profile CLI is exposed.
